findings.where: hero primary CTA 'Get KinAI for Free' and header 'Download', 1440
findings.evidence: focus.json stop 3: outline 'none', focus shown only as a 1px rgb(0,209,195) ring on a button filled with the same #00d1c3; focus/03-on.png is indistinguishable from the resting state apart from the existing glow.
findings.before: outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #00d1c3 on a #00d1c3 fill
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.7 Focus Visible: a same-colour 1px ring on a same-colour fill gives no perceptible indicator on the page's main action.

findings.evidence: The large screenshot (welcome.png) has alt "Your family's AI. Nobody else's.", which repeats the visible caption under it; the image's actual message ('What Mom asks stays Mom's... including whoever runs this computer', 'Get started') is in pixels only. 'Vision Routing' and 'Inline Image Search' alts are titles, not descriptions.
findings.after: alt="KinAI welcome screen: 'What Mom asks stays Mom's. Every family member's conversations are sealed to them, including whoever runs this computer.' with a Get started button"
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content: alt should carry what the screenshot tells the reader, not repeat the caption.

findings.evidence: Download links are named 'Intel Mac', 'Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4)', 'MSI Installer (Recommended)', '.deb (Debian / Ubuntu)': out of context a links list does not say these download a file or which app.
findings.after: Download KinAI for Intel Mac (.dmg), or an aria-describedby to the card heading.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context); 2.4.9 (AAA) out of context.

findings.evidence: dom-1440.json landmarks: main 1, nav 1, footer 1, header 0; the first focusable is the version badge 'v0.2.147' and there is no skip link before the 7 carousel buttons.
findings.before: Top bar without <header>; no skip link
findings.after:
Wrap the top bar in
; add Skip to content as the first focusable.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships / 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks.

strengths: Every screenshot and logo has a non-empty alt; carousel thumbnails are real buttons named by their slide.
FAQ uses native buttons inside h3 headings; install guide uses a Radix tablist with named tabs.
Focus order follows the visual order (focus.json y sequence is monotonic).
not_investigated: disputed: focus_ring 'focused element is covered by a fixed or sticky element' fires on all 29 stops, including the hero CTA; focus/03-on.png shows the CTA fully visible, so the cover is likely a full-page fixed background layer, not a real obstruction.
disputed: contrast on h1 span 'with your family.' (1.06:1 against #bfc0c3) — the tile shows cyan on near-black, clearly legible; the sampler read the gradient-clipped first line, not the background.

disputed in part: contrast hits on feature cards with text opacity 0.15-0.70 ('Guided Family Setup', 'Parallel Research') are fade-in animation frames; the real defect is ROB-001 (content depends on IntersectionObserver), already in the sweep.
Carousel auto-advance and pause control (2.2.2): needs a live session.
Keyboard operation of tabs and accordion not run live.
